---
title: "Fixed spectral radius: varying cross-variable coupling"
author: "Ace I. Mejia-Sanchez"
date: "2026-11-14"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This file provides the fixed-spectral-radius experiment. All three transition matrices have rho(A) = 0.2, while their first superdiagonal coupling gamma varies (which reflect different versions of temporal and cross-variable dependence). The experiment runs 20 LASSO replications per condition, approximates spectral extrema on a frequency grid, and plots absolute/relative coefficient errors. 

```{r}
source("00_requirements.R")
source("02_funct_MethodImplementation.R")
source("04_funct_SpectralAnalysis.R")
load("data/simulation_objects.RData")

stopifnot(exists("make_lagged_design", mode = "function"),
          exists("fit_equations", mode = "function"))
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install ggplot2 before running this extension.")
}

set.seed(92508)
p_ext <- ncol(data_VAR_weakDEP)
n_ext <- nrow(data_VAR_weakDEP)
burn_ext <- 250L
n_reps <- 20L       # Use 5 for an initial quick run; then 20+ for figures
rho_target <- 0.20
gamma_values <- c(0.05, 0.25, 0.50)

# Generate stationary-approximate VAR(1) trajectories from common Gaussian
# innovations, discarding burn-in observations.
A_candidates <- lapply(gamma_values, function(gamma) {
  A <- diag(rho_target, p_ext)
  A[cbind(seq_len(p_ext - 1L), seq.int(2L, p_ext))] <- gamma
  A
})
names(A_candidates) <- as.character(gamma_values)

spectral_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(gamma_values), function(i) {
  A <- A_candidates[[i]]
  ext <- spectral_extrema(A)
  data.frame(gamma = gamma_values[i],
             spectral_radius = max(Mod(eigen(A, only.values = TRUE)$values)),
             A_Frobenius = norm(A, type = "F"),
             true_nonzero = sum(abs(A) > 1e-10),
             M_approx = unname(ext["M_approx"]),
             m_approx = unname(ext["m_approx"]))
}))
stopifnot(all(abs(spectral_table$spectral_radius - rho_target) < 1e-9))
stopifnot(length(unique(spectral_table$true_nonzero)) == 1L)

# Matched innovations within replication reduce Monte Carlo noise in contrasts.
results <- vector("list", n_reps * length(gamma_values))
idx <- 0L
for (r in seq_len(n_reps)) {
  innovations <- matrix(rnorm((n_ext + burn_ext) * p_ext),
                        nrow = n_ext + burn_ext, ncol = p_ext)
  for (i in seq_along(gamma_values)) {
    gamma <- gamma_values[i]
    A <- A_candidates[[i]]
    Y <- simulate_var1(A, innovations, burn_ext)
    fit <- fit_equations(make_lagged_design(Y), method = "LASSO")
    idx <- idx + 1L
    results[[idx]] <- data.frame(
      repetition = r,
      gamma = gamma,
      absolute_A_error = norm(fit$A_hat - A, type = "F"),
      relative_A_error = norm(fit$A_hat - A, type = "F") / norm(A, type = "F"),
      test_one_step_MSE = fit$test_mse,
      true_nonzero = sum(abs(A) > 1e-10),
      selected_nonzero = sum(abs(fit$A_hat) > 1e-7)
    )
  }
  if (r %% 5L == 0L) message("Completed ", r, " of ", n_reps, " replications")
}
mc_results <- do.call(rbind, results)

# Summarize means and across-replication standard deviations.
mc_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(mc_results, mc_results$gamma), function(z) {
  data.frame(gamma = z$gamma[1], n_reps = nrow(z),
             mean_absolute_A_error = mean(z$absolute_A_error),
             sd_absolute_A_error = sd(z$absolute_A_error),
             mean_relative_A_error = mean(z$relative_A_error),
             sd_relative_A_error = sd(z$relative_A_error),
             mean_test_MSE = mean(z$test_one_step_MSE))
}))
row.names(mc_summary) <- NULL
mc_summary <- merge(mc_summary, spectral_table, by = "gamma", sort = TRUE)

cat("\nFixed-spectral-radius design and Monte Carlo results:\n")
print(mc_summary, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)

library(ggplot2)
plot_fixed_rho_error <- ggplot(mc_results,
                              aes(x = factor(gamma), y = absolute_A_error)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.50, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "#b1ccdf") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, alpha = 0.30, size = 1.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3.2, shape = 18,
               color = "#233b53") +
  labs(title = "LASSO estimation error at a fixed spectral radius",
       subtitle = paste0("rho(A) = ", rho_target,
                         "; ", n_reps, " replications per coupling level"),
       x = "Off-diagonal coupling (gamma)",
       y = "Absolute Frobenius error of A")

plot_spectral_peak <- ggplot(spectral_table, aes(x = gamma, y = M_approx)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "#3b78a4") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#3b78a4") +
  labs(title = paste0("Spectral peak, rho(A) = ", rho_target,
                         "; approximate M(f_X) on a frequency grid"),
       x = "Off-diagonal coupling (gamma)",
       y = "Approximate spectral stability measure M(f_X)")

plot_fixed_rho_relative <- ggplot(mc_results,
                                 aes(x = factor(gamma), y = relative_A_error)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.50, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "#b1ccdf") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, alpha = 0.30, size = 1.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3.2, shape = 18,
               color = "#233b53") +
  labs(title = "Relative LASSO est. error at fixed spectral radius",
       subtitle = "(true coeff norm changes with gamma)",
       x = "Off-diagonal coupling (gamma)",
       y = "Relative Frobenius error of A")

print(plot_fixed_rho_error)
print(plot_spectral_peak)
print(plot_fixed_rho_relative)

dir.create("presentation_outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(mc_results,
          "presentation_outputs/fixed_radius_repeated_results.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(mc_summary,
          "presentation_outputs/fixed_radius_summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
ggsave("presentation_outputs/fixed_radius_error.png", plot_fixed_rho_error,
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 180)
ggsave("presentation_outputs/fixed_radius_spectral_peak.png", plot_spectral_peak,
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 180)
ggsave("presentation_outputs/fixed_radius_relative_error.png", plot_fixed_rho_relative,
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 180)
```
